**RA Progress Statement — Winter 2027 Funding Review**  
**Project:** Seoul–Daegu Honorific Shift Corpus (NSF-funded)  
**Reporting date:** November 9, 2026  

I am the sole RA responsible for Korean annotation on this project. The fall-term target is 6,000 annotated utterances; as of this report, I have completed 4,200.

The annotation schedule was directly affected by a six-week wait for required IRB authorization. On September 3, 2026, I sent Prof. Hollander the amendment needed to add 14 new Daegu recordings for her signature. I sent follow-up reminders on September 12, September 24, and October 6, and I have retained copies of these emails. Prof. Hollander signed the amendment on October 15. Until then, I was not permitted to annotate the new recordings.

During that waiting period, I recoded the existing 2,300 utterances using the revised speech-level scheme Prof. Hollander requested in August. This work was not part of the original fall timeline and should count as progress toward the project’s annotation goals.

Since October 15, I have annotated approximately 1,900 additional utterances. This represents an average of more than 500 utterances per week, compared with the planned rate of 350 per week. At my current post-authorization pace, I expect to complete the remaining 1,800 utterances and reach the 6,000-utterance target by January 31, 2027.

At the November 6 lab meeting, my annotation was described as “six weeks behind,” and Prof. Hollander said this would be noted for the review. Standing alone, that description does not accurately represent the cause of the delay or my rate of work. The six-week period from September 3 to October 15 corresponds to the time spent awaiting the required signature, during which I completed substantial additional recoding.

For the Winter 2027 funding review, I request that the “six weeks behind” comment either be omitted or, if retained, be accompanied by the full timeline above. I also ask that my funding record include the September 3–October 15 authorization delay, the recoding completed during that period, my annotation rate since October 15, and my expected completion date of January 31, 2027.
